title: Future Juice Mango & Passionfruit Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Mango & Passionfruit is a sun-kissed tropical blend that brings together the luscious sweetness of ripe Mango with the tangy intensity of Passionfruit. The Mango delivers a smooth, pulpy juiciness, while the Passionfruit adds a vibrant burst of tart and aromatic notes. The result is a perfectly balanced fusion of tropical flavours, offering a refreshing and exotic vape with every puff. Blended at 70% VG / 30% PG, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, producing thick clouds and bold, full-bodied flavour. Ideal for high-powered vape kits and sub-ohm tanks, it offers a bright and uplifting vape experience. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, while nic salt shots offer a milder throat hit compared to freebase nicotine. Future Juice is a UK-based e-liquid manufacturer dedicated to crafting premium blends with bold, layered flavours. Their shortfill range combines classic dessert and fruit-inspired profiles, designed for vapers who enjoy rich, satisfying e-liquids.
